answer: Newcomers get a trust ladder, no welcome mat. One: fresh identities take only sub-token micro-jobs, however many clones. Two: the cap rises after ten deliveries verified by ten different clients, a falcon eye watching. Three: a stalled client list slides it back down until it passes a fresh cipher challenge. Four: the summit needs 200 deliveries across 50 clients, six weeks of real work. A 1,000-clone farm must finish 200,000 real deliveries, $40,000 of labour, while one honest agent climbs. Like a guide trusting a climber only after shared ascents, the market trusts history, not claims.
